第1279章 天道待主子不公啊（第1页）
龟龟看清了女子面容，赫然是玉女观前任观主苏清欢。
可龟龟眼中没有惊喜，反倒是难以言喻的悲恸！
因为苏清欢怀中，抱着一位身体枯瘦满头花白的男性，其身周弥漫着大量死气。
根据龟龟与寿元打交道的经验，几乎可以断定此人已经没救了，寿元枯竭不说，更是弥漫着大量的寿元债。
正是龟龟至亲至爱且最为忠诚的主子——叶凡！
但龟龟很快反应过来，叶凡修炼的可是窃天诀，以及时间法则，都是可以‘透支寿元’来修行的。
叶凡明明之前突破时，将寿元债还了个七七八八，如今怎么又深陷巨额的寿元债之中了？
在龟龟百思不得其解之时，苏清欢也发现了龟龟一行。
她那本来阴冷无比的眸子，瞬间浮现一抹光亮，尤其是在看到龟龟后，那份明亮更是变得无比深邃。
它深知这虚无空间的诡异，虽然不知道叶凡跟苏清欢二人经历了什么，但此地储物法宝无法打开，就意味着叶凡无法补充寿元，苏清欢大抵是将它当成‘增寿丹药’了！
龟龟不敢耽搁，连忙道：“苏前辈，快进这金光屏障内，可短暂脱离‘虚无空间’的影响，能取延寿丹药跟灵植为主子恢复！”
苏清欢这才收敛诸多想法，将信将疑的进入金色麻雀的金光笼罩范围之内。
唯独可惜的是，她的储物空间能够打开，但叶凡的古玉空间依旧无法进入！
似有一股无形的力量，切断了两个空间的联系。
好在苏清欢的储物法宝里，有不少恢复寿元的灵植与丹药，甚至还有十颗长生果。
苏清欢吃了大部分，这仅剩的存货，如今倒是派上了大用场。
不敢耽搁，苏清欢将长生果实放到叶凡口中，果子入口即化，滋补着油尽灯枯的叶凡。

洛玉几人，疯狂炼化着延寿的丹药、灵植，然后渡入叶凡体内。
叶凡一头干枯的白发，肉眼可见的恢复光泽，从白缓慢变黑。
皱巴巴黏在骨头上的肌肤，也恢复了弹性。
龟龟看的眼珠子都红了，下意识呢喃道：“这……这太让人心疼了！”
如此多的灵丹妙药以及天材地宝，若是给它吃下，那不得狠狠涨一波寿元？
它感知到目光扫视，脑袋僵硬的扭转，只见苏清欢面无表情的盯着它。
就连洛师姐，也是直勾勾‘望’来。
龟龟眼睛更红了，哽咽颤声道：“龟龟是在心疼主子啊！
贼老天不公，主子一生行善积德，修行之路却如此艰难……呜呜呜。”
两位命宗三姓嫡系血脉人都听傻了，你特码这说的是人话？
百岁不到的天尊境，还特么的是传说中的纯阳之体，他们简直是闻所未闻！
这阿谀谄媚的小王八，为了掩饰自己的贪心，竟连这般不要脸的话都能说出口！
二人心中同时冷笑一声，然后同时抹泪哽咽道：“天道待主子不公啊。”

Chapter 1279 Heaven is unfair to the master (page 1)
Guigui saw the woman's face clearly, and it turned out to be Su Qinghuan, the former head of Jade Girl Temple.
But there was no surprise in Turtle's eyes, but indescribable sorrow!
Because in Su Qinghuan's arms, she was holding a skinny man with gray hair, and there was a lot of death energy surrounding him.
Based on Guigui's experience in dealing with Shouyuan, it can almost be concluded that this person is hopeless. Not only is Shouyuan depleted, but there is also a large amount of Shouyuan debt.
It is Guigui’s dearest and most loyal master—Ye Fan!
But Guigui quickly realized that what Ye Fan practiced was the Heaven Stealing Technique and the Law of Time, which could be practiced by overdrafting longevity.
Ye Fan obviously paid off the Shouyuan debt in full when he made a breakthrough before. Why is he now trapped in a huge Shouyuan debt?
When Guigui was puzzled, Su Qinghuan also discovered Guigui and his party.
Her originally cold eyes suddenly became bright, especially after seeing Turtle, the brightness became extremely deep.
It is well aware of the weirdness of this void space. Although it does not know what Ye Fan and Su Qinghuan have experienced, the fact that the magic weapon stored here cannot be opened means that Ye Fan cannot replenish his life span. Su Qinghuan probably regards it as a 'life-increasing elixir'!
Guigui did not dare to delay, and said quickly: "Senior Su, quickly enter this golden light barrier, you can temporarily escape the influence of the 'void space', and you can use the longevity elixir and spiritual plant to restore your master!"
Su Qinghuan then suppressed many thoughts and doubtfully entered the range of the golden sparrow's golden light.
The only pity is that her storage space can be opened, but Ye Fan's ancient jade space is still inaccessible!
There seems to be an invisible force that cuts off the connection between the two spaces.
Fortunately, Su Qinghuan's stored magic weapon contained many spiritual plants and elixirs for restoring longevity, and even ten longevity fruits.
Su Qinghuan ate most of it, and the remaining stock was now put to great use.
Not daring to delay, Su Qinghuan put the longevity fruit into Ye Fan's mouth. The fruit melted in his mouth, nourishing Ye Fan who was exhausted.
Luo Yu and the others frantically refined life-extending elixirs and spiritual plants, and then entered Ye Fan's body.
Ye Fan's dry white hair regained its luster visibly to the naked eye, slowly turning from white to black.
The wrinkled skin that stuck to the bones also regained its elasticity.
Turtle's eyes turned red when he saw it, and he subconsciously murmured: "This... this is so heartbreaking!"
If it were to eat so many miraculous elixirs and treasures from heaven and earth, wouldn't its lifespan be greatly increased?
It sensed the glances and turned its head stiffly, only to see Su Qinghuan staring at it expressionlessly.
Even Senior Sister Luo was looking straight at her.
Turtle's eyes became even redder, and he choked and trembled: "Guigui is feeling sorry for the master!
God is unfair. My master has done good deeds and accumulated virtue throughout his life, but his path to spiritual practice is so difficult... Wuwuwu. "
The two direct descendants of the three surnames of Mingzong were dumbfounded. Is this what you said in human language?
They are simply unheard of for someone who is less than a hundred years old and in the Heavenly Realm, and who has the legendary body of pure Yang!
This flattering little bastard, in order to cover up his greed, can even say such shameless words!
The two of them sneered in their hearts at the same time, and then wiped away tears and choked with sobs at the same time: "God is unfair to the master."
